game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing, a cracking glacier: the sherpa guide must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing: a cracking glacier
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Crossing, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round, frost wyrms strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gate value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing: keep the gate meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: gate drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Glacier Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while gate > 0.
